description: Implementation of LwM2MModelConfigService for managing and sending model configuration updates in a Thingsboard LwM2M transport module.

classes.name: LwM2MModelConfigServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class implementing configuration management and update dispatch for LwM2M models in Thingsboard.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes current model configurations from the store after startup.

methods.name: sendUpdates
methods.description: Sends configuration updates to a specific LwM2mClient based on current configs.

methods.name: sendUpdates
methods.description: Merges new model config into existing and triggers update process.

methods.name: doSend
methods.description: Performs the actual sending of model configuration updates, including attributes, reads, and observe settings.

methods.name: doSendCancelObserve
methods.description: Handles canceling observe requests based on strategy.

methods.name: doSendObserve
methods.description: Sends observe requests based on the configured observe strategy.

methods.name: createDownlinkProxyCallback
methods.description: Creates a callback wrapper to handle success, validation errors, and errors during downlink requests.

methods.name: persistUpdates
methods.description: Persists current model configuration for a given endpoint.

methods.name: removeUpdates
methods.description: Removes configuration for a given endpoint from current configs and store.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Saves all non-empty configs to store before shutdown.
